## Core Technologies & CMS Stacks
- **WordPress**: Custom PHP theme development, Advanced Custom Fields (ACF Pro), Native Gutenberg block creation, WooCommerce custom storefronts, Elementor Pro, Breakdance Builder, Divi 5, REST API integrations, and Redis caching.
- **Shopify**: Shopify Theme 2.0 architecture, Liquid templating, Dawn theme custom sections, variant swatch logic, AJAX slide carts, and conversion optimization.
- **Wix Studio & Wix**: Certified Wix Studio builder, Velo JavaScript programming, dynamic CMS collections, custom repeater APIs, and dataset filtering.
- **Webflow**: Figma-to-Webflow development, Finsweet Client-First style systems, CMS collections, and responsive interactions.
- **Squarespace**: Fluid Engine customizations, custom CSS/JS injection, and layout overrides.
- **Frontend Core**: Semantic HTML5, Modern CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React 19, Tailwind CSS.
